fixture: Copied public Token-2022 mint bytes with synthetic transfer fee and disposable authority; program-created LP mint and ATAs; signed deposits, wrapped-SOL funding, LP add/remove and local MintTo top-up.
conclusion: With 100 bps, an LP's full withdrawal of its own minted shares fails because the spendable vault is 10 million raw tokens short of that LP's gross payout. The rejected transaction rolls back. A signed local 10 million raw token top-up lets it exit, but the remaining Curve reserve is still unbacked by 1 billion raw tokens and the minimum-token check accepts a gross amount above the LP's spendable receipt. The otherwise identical 0 bps control exits without a top-up.
qualification: All signing keys, transfer-fee configuration, LP position, and tokens are synthetic on two fresh offline ledgers. This is a conditional compatibility and liquidity-exit risk, not proof of an affected live Curve, unauthorized withdrawal, or current user loss.
